annotations.title: Is the Upgrade Worth It? Flight and Hotel Upgrade Calculator

description: All prices and values are the caller’s own: the tool holds no fares or upgrade prices, and the defaults are an illustrative example. Cash: upgrade cost = upgradedPrice − basePrice (never below 0). Points: upgradePoints × pencePerPoint ÷ 100 + upgradePointsCash. Flight benefits: sleep hours (capped at flight hours, only if sleepMatters = yes) × sleepValuePerHour + flightHours × comfortPerHour + lounge + baggage + fastTrack; hotel benefits: nights × (roomValuePerNight + includedPerNight). Both add flexibility + other. Worth it when benefits ≥ cost. Prices are per person (flight) or for the stay (hotel). Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/is-the-upgrade-worth-it-calculator

baggage.description: Flight: value of extra baggage, e.g. the bag fee otherwise paid.

basePrice.description: Price of what is booked now: per person for a flight, for the whole stay for a hotel.

comfortPerHour.description: Flight: value of extra space, food and quiet per flight hour.

flexibility.description: Value of better change or refund terms.

flightHours.description: Flight: total flight hours the upgrade covers.

includedPerNight.description: Hotel: cash saved per night on included extras (breakfast, club lounge).

lounge.description: Flight: value of lounge access, e.g. the day pass otherwise bought.

other.description: Any other saving or value from the upgrade.

pencePerPoint.description: Points only: the caller’s own value per point in pence or cents (illustrative default, not a sourced valuation).

roomValuePerNight.description: Hotel: value of the better room per night.

sleepHours.description: Flight: extra hours of usable sleep expected from the upgrade (capped at flightHours).

sleepMatters.description: Flight: yes to count the value of extra sleep, no to leave it out.

sleepValuePerHour.description: Flight: value of each extra hour of sleep (arriving rested).

upgradePoints.description: Points only: points asked for the upgrade.

upgradePointsCash.description: Points only: cash payable with the points (taxes, surcharges, co-pay).

upgradeType.description: flight (cabin upgrade) or hotel (room or suite upgrade).

upgradedPrice.description: Cash only: price of the upgraded cabin or room, same basis as basePrice.
